command: set -u; echo '===HOST==='; hostname; id -un; date -Is; echo '===REPOS==='; for d in /home/andreas/frankenstein-repo /home/andreas/frankenstein /home/andreas/self-integration /home/andreas/frank-repo; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo "REPO=$d"; git -C "$d" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; printf 'DIRTY='; git -C "$d" status --porcelain=v1 2>/dev/null | wc -l; fi; done; echo '===BRIDGE==='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===VM_READONLY==='; systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecMainPID -p DropInPaths --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===VOLATILE_GUARD==='; systemctl cat entityos-vm.service 2>/dev/null | grep -n -E 'fluechtig-vor-start|ExecStartPre|volatile-state' || true; echo '===DURABLE_DB==='; ls -l /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===VOLATILE_DBS==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then stat -c '%n %s %Y' "$p"; else echo "MISSING $p"; fi; done
